description: Land Acquisition - Kedalagama, Division No. 11 Muthiyangana and Division No. 4 Hidagoda, Badulla D/S Division, Badulla
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific lots of land being acquired for public purpose (road widening). It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, their locations, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property matters.
